title: Hot-day behavior change, Philadelphia (held-out 2022)
description: Real: Google Community Mobility Reports, Philadelphia County, summer weekdays of 2022, hot days (PHL high ≥ 92°F, n=16) vs typical days (78–88°F, n=30), compared within month. Simulated: the same residents on the real median hot day (2020-07-19) vs the real median typical summer day (2015-09-06). The three behavior parameters were fit on 2020–21 only.
error_label: Held-out (2022) mean absolute error: 0.6 percentage points across 6 categories

calibration.version: prototype v1 · synthetic day, everyone warned cancels outdoor plans
prototype v2 · synthetic day, hand-tuned cancel / shift / go
real data · fit on 2020–21 (cancel 0%, shift 30%, vulnerable decide like others), train

notes: Caveats: mobility data are from the COVID era (2020–22) and measure visits relative to a Jan–Feb 2020 baseline; the simulation measures resident-hours. ATUS diaries from five I-95 metros could not pin down the hot-day change on their own (95% interval spans a 55% drop to a 160% rise in afternoon outdoor leisure), so they set the routines but not the hot-day parameters.
